standard-dialogue.player: Hello, what are you doing here, so far from home?

standard-dialogue.npc: I'm enjoyn' the local hoschpitalieee. hee hee.

standard-dialogue.player: Looks like you've enjoyed more than your fair share of hospitality.

standard-dialogue.npc: tee hee, I probblie schoodn' 'av anuva drinkie right now. But dis dwarven beer ish kind of moreish after the fiff pint.

standard-dialogue.player: I'd go easy on the dwarven stout if I were you.

standard-dialogue.npc: I yousht to be a tesht pilot yoo know. I reeel hero.
But I loscht my bottle. Scho I now ffind scholiss in the bottle.

standard-dialogue.player: What happened? Did you have a glider crash or get attacked by huge flying birds or something?

standard-dialogue.npc: Naaah, I realished I woz scared ov heightsh.

standard-dialogue.player: Ah, I can see that would be a problem ... You should keep an eye on your drinking, though.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Ninto.

steps.npc: Aaa shomefing ter go wiv my beer. Thish dwarf beerz quite shtrong you know...

steps.text: If the reward is a gnome scarf:

steps.npc: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.

steps.text: You are given a gnome pilot's scarf as a tip.
If the reward is a pair of gnome goggles:

steps.npc: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.

steps.text: You are given a pair of pilot's goggles as a tip.
If the reward is anything else:

steps.npc: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.

steps.text: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
